I am a computational biologist/data scientist/bioinformatician/bioengineer who enjoys learning from complex biological data sets and collaborating. (My pronouns are she/her.)

I am currently the Chief Operating Officer at [Synthesize Bio](https://www.synthesize.bio) My prior professional experience includes roles at [Pathos](https://pathos.com), Bristol Myers Squibb, and Janssen (Johnson & Johnson). My work sits at the intersection of machine learning, molecular data, and drug development. I have led teams across all stages of drug development, from target identification through approval. [Google Scholar page](https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=G9Icw9EAAAAJ&hl=en).

I was a founding organizer of the [Philadelphia chapter](https://www.rladiesphilly.org) of [R-Ladies](https://rladies.org). 

I live in the Philadelphia area. I spend my free time watching television and improving my artistic skills through painting, quilting, and other creative pursuits.

You can find me online on [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/alice-walsh/) and [GitHub](https://github.com/awalsh17).
